note: Lanes for parallel feature agents (build-family overnight lanes): each open need key under the rank goal, small or unsized, in the part of the engine it is built in. One agent a lane at a time; decisions is solo (one agent at most, client work). Majors are not laned: the user approves each, and it runs alone. `cards:goal -- --lane <name>` lists a lane; `groups` are keys that look like one general implementation (the B322 triage): a group goes to one agent whole. A key missing here prints as "?".

groups.why: All move a spell off the stack to exile or a library (Possibility Storm, Gale's Redirection, Forger's Foundry, Goliath Daydreamer, Neera, Knowledge Pool): one stack-to-zone move with its link/counter/as-it-resolves options. casting-zones.

An untargeted chosen set acted on together: flicker over a choose-permanents set (Nahiri's Resolve, Fortune), and the same set read by later steps (Spry and Mighty's thisWay chosen). One 'chosen this way' set ref.
create-token-copy's `of` widened: a paid/sacrificed object's copiable values (LKI), every card matching a filter in a zone, and an attached-to form.
sharesCreatureTypeWith over a set: the convoking creatures, and 'each of' the tapped set rather than 'any of' (Everything Comes to Dust, Cryptic Gateway).
zone-choice-together.ts already has 'variety' and 'distinct' rules; each card needs a definition field that reaches them (Winter, Nethergoyf's escape cost, Seasons Past). One wiring pass.
An any-number target group that isn't the last slot of its list (Filigree Vector, Kamahl's Will).
An opponent's binary guess about a hidden card, compared on reveal (Gollum, Master of Predicaments).
One pick spanning permanents and cards in hand/graveyard (Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God; Lich's Mastery).
create-emblem with an activated ability of its own (Ob Nixilis of the Black Oath, Karn, Living Legacy).
delayed-trigger extensions: targets chosen as it fires, a watched this-way set, a from-graveyard return at your next upkeep, and a bolstered creature as the watched object.
The sacrifice cost's count and filter: up to N, X of them (and a token stack), mana value X, and two for a graveyard cast.
Reads of what was declared at attack declaration, kept in the journal (who attacked whom, with which creatures, under which requirements). Faramir's may already be covered by attacked-you-last-turn.
Each player chooses a set they keep and loses the rest (Stick Together, Unstable Glyphbridge).
Exiling from the bottom of a library (Arvinox, The Temporal Anchor): impulse-exile/exile-from-library taking the bottom.
Variants on the impulse/play permission: a filter comparing exiled cards, a rider on the spell cast, another player's library top, and a pool every player may use.
cast-now options: where the card goes after, what the spell gains, and choosing one card of a linked set to copy.
Casting from the graveyard with a named alternative (Adventure, mutate, bestow) or a rider on the permanent (enters tapped).
others-enter-battlefield options: exile instead if not cast, and entering face down (beside the enterAs/asCopyOf it already has).
Each is a TRIGGER_EVENTS row (plus, for investigate and pays-life, the event): phased-out and scried already carry what's needed; one agent can add the rows together.
Coin-flip effect options: pass-indexed amounts and who decides to go on.
Sanctum Lurker and Deification: planeswalker loyalty survival and a planeswalker-type choice.
X in a cost fixed by counters on the source (Chromatic Armor, Voodoo Doll); Chromatic Armor also remembers the colour chosen as it resolves, which Zombie Boa shares.
Power and toughness from what was sacrificed as it entered (Wood Elemental, Dracoplasm).
Runesword: both of its keys.
Vizier of the Anointed: both of its keys.
